title: Japan Grand Tour with Blossom and City Lights
alt: Cherry blossom along a canal with city towers behind, Japan
transport: Shinkansen bullet train, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.subtitle: Tokyo to Mount Fuji and Disneyland
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Well placed hotel in Shinjuku, minutes from the station

activities.name: Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip
activities.match: Mount Fuji and Hakone 1 Day Tour
activities.description: The fifth station on Mount Fuji, Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway, with the bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening.

activities.name: Tokyo city tour with lunch
activities.description: A full day by coach from the LOVE statue in Shinjuku through Meiji shrine, the Imperial Palace gardens and Asakusa, with lunch included.

activities.name: Tokyo Disneyland
activities.description: A full day at Tokyo Disneyland with your admission tickets included, so you can be at the gates when the park opens.

program.name: Tokyo
program.description: Four nights in Shinjuku with Mount Fuji and Hakone first, then a full city day and a day at Disneyland.

stops.name: Hiroshima
stops.subtitle: Hiroshima to Miyajima
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 4★ · Four star hotel attached to Hiroshima station

activities.name: Hiroshima and Miyajima tour
activities.description: The Peace Memorial Park and museum in the morning, then the ferry to Miyajima for the floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine.

program.name: Hiroshima
program.description: Two nights beside the station, with a free arrival day and the Peace Memorial Park paired with the island shrine.

stops.name: Osaka
stops.subtitle: Osaka to Kyoto, Nara and Universal Studios

activities.name: Osaka walking tour
activities.description: Half a day on foot through Dotonbori, the Kuromon market and the lanes around Shinsekai with a guide who knows where to eat.

activities.name: Kyoto and Nara with buffet lunch
activities.description: Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, then the deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara, with a buffet lunch and coach travel from Namba.

activities.name: Universal Studios Japan
activities.description: A full day at Universal Studios Japan with tickets included, home to Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area.

program.name: Osaka
program.description: Five nights in one hotel with a walking tour, Kyoto and Nara, Universal Studios Japan and a free day before you fly home.

1: Arrival at Narita or Haneda and transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Shinjuku hotel
Rest of the day free at your own pace
Optional: the Tokyo Metropolitan Building viewing decks, free of charge
2: Breakfast, then out of the city towards Mount Fuji
The fifth station on the mountain, weather permitting
Lake Ashi and the Hakone ropeway
Bullet train back into Tokyo in the evening
3: Breakfast, then a full day coach tour of the city
Meiji shrine and the Imperial Palace gardens
Asakusa and the Senso-ji temple lanes
4: Early breakfast, then across to Tokyo Disneyland
Admission tickets included for the full day
5: Breakfast and check out, then transfer to the station
Shinkansen bullet train west to Hiroshima
Check in at your hotel beside the station
Rest of the day free in the city
6: Breakfast, then the Peace Memorial Park and museum
The A-Bomb Dome and the memorial cenotaph
The floating torii gate and Itsukushima shrine
7: Breakfast and check out, then back to the station
Check in at your hotel in the centre
Rest of the day free in the city
8: Breakfast, then a half day walking tour of Osaka
Dotonbori and the Kuromon market stalls
The lanes around Shinsekai with your guide
9: Breakfast, then a full day out to Kyoto and Nara
Kinkaku-ji, the golden pavilion, on its pond
The deer park and Todai-ji temple in Nara
10: Early breakfast, then across to Universal Studios Japan
Tickets included for the full day
Super Nintendo World and the Harry Potter area
11: Breakfast and a free day in Osaka
Optional: Osaka castle and its park
Optional: a day trip to Himeji or Kobe by train
Optional: the aquarium at Osaka Bay
12: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to Kansai Airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: Twelve days means you can put Fuji on day two and still have a free day at the end. Nothing is rushed.
expert.tip: Taking Mount Fuji early is deliberate: if the cloud sits low we can swap it with the city day and you still get the mountain.

summary: Twelve days across three cities: four nights in Shinjuku with Mount Fuji, a city tour and Tokyo Disneyland, two in Hiroshima for the Peace Memorial Park and Miyajima, then five in Osaka with a walking tour, Kyoto and Nara, Universal Studios and a free day.
included: Included: 11 nights with daily breakfast; bullet train between Tokyo, Hiroshima and Osaka; private airport transfers; Mount Fuji and Hakone day trip; full day Tokyo city tour with lunch; Tokyo Disneyland tickets; Hiroshima and Miyajima tour; Osaka half day walking tour; Kyoto and Nara day trip with buffet lunch; Universal Studios Japan tickets.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
